verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that users generate an API key and send it as a bearer token, and that Anrok markets handing tax work to agents. Nothing documents scoped, permission-limited, read-only or per-agent credentials, so least-privilege issuance is unevidenced for this applicable SaaS API axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
